'Gratitude to brave soldiers': PM Modi pays tribute to Kargil heroes on Vijay Diwas
articles.description: India is observing the 27th anniversary of Kargil Vijay Diwas, commemorating its victory in the 1999 Kargil War. The day marks the successful culmination of Operation Vijay and honours the 527 soldiers who made the supreme sacrifice while driving Pakistani intruders out of strategic heights in the Kargil sector. The Kargil conflict, fought between May and July 1999, remains the only conventional war between two nuclear-armed neighbours.

articles.title: Two killed after small plane crashes into house in Germany
articles.description: A light aircraft crashed into a house roof in Ganderkesee, Germany. Two men, aged sixty-five and seventy-seven, were killed in the accident. Authorities conducted a complex recovery operation to remove the embedded wreckage. Residents of the affected home were evacuated during the emergency response. German officials have initiated an investigation into the cause of the crash.

articles.title: Tariffs on trial: Small businesses take Trump's latest trade levies back to court
articles.description: Two groups of small businesses are challenging Donald Trump's latest tariffs in court. These new levies target goods from sixty trading partners and cover nearly all US imports. Businesses argue the administration failed to justify these measures against individual economies. They contend the tariffs replace previous worldwide duties struck down by the Supreme Court. Legal experts believe these new tariffs will likely remain in place for an extended period.

articles.title: Who is Pralhad Joshi, the new education minister? A look at his education, career and political journey
articles.description: Pralhad Joshi has assumed additional charge as Union education minister following Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over the NEET-UG 2026 controversy. A five-time MP from Karnataka, Joshi holds a bachelor's degree from Shri Kadasiddheshwar Arts College, Hubballi. He now faces the task of steering examination reforms, strengthening the National Education Policy's implementation and rebuilding trust in India's education system.
